title: Guasca and the Paramo
slogan: North-east out of Bogotá onto the páramo: frailejón, cloud and a road at three thousand metres that feels a long way from the city it starts in.

waypoints.name: La Calera
waypoints.advice: La Calera is where the day begins. Next is Guasca, 29 km on.

waypoints.name: Guasca
waypoints.advice: Guasca comes up 29 km in. Next is Guatavita, 30 km on.

waypoints.name: Guatavita
waypoints.advice: 59 km in you reach Guatavita. Next is Sesquilé, 29 km on.

provenance: MANUAL SEED: every stop was entered by hand from a known position on the road. The distance is the seed figure, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces it. Altitudes are present only where they were known; the rest are null rather than zero.

scenicChapters.title: Guasca and the Paramo
scenicChapters.narrative: Exposed ground: wind matters more here than gradient. Nothing blocks it. Height already gained and held. The road stays near 2710 m for 19 km instead of surrendering it to the next valley.

title: Villa de Leyva Road
slogan: North from Bogotá into Boyacá: dry hills, a colonial town of cobbles and the desert valley behind it.

waypoints.name: Tunja
waypoints.advice: Tunja is where the day begins. Reckon on about 4 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Arcabuco, 57 km on and mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Arcabuco
waypoints.advice: Arcabuco comes up 57 km in. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Villa de Leyva, 58 km on and mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Villa de Leyva
waypoints.advice: 115 km in you reach Villa de Leyva. You lose 460 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Ráquira, 57 km on.

sections.advice: Tunja → Arcabuco, 34 km. Part of Villa de Leyva Road.
Arcabuco → Villa de Leyva, 22 km, dropping about 460 m. Part of Villa de Leyva Road.
Villa de Leyva → Ráquira, 20 km. Part of Villa de Leyva Road.

provenance: MANUAL SEED: every stop was entered by hand from a known position on the road. The distance is the seed figure, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces it. Altitudes are present only where they were known; the rest are null rather than zero.

scenicChapters.title: Villa de Leyva Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Height already gained and held. The road stays near 2820 m for 76 km instead of surrendering it to the next valley — exposed ground: wind matters more here than gradient. Nothing blocks it.

scenicChapters.title: Villa de Leyva Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 50 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
